instruction: Explain what LoRA fine-tuning is in one short paragraph.
output: LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) adds small trainable matrices to a frozen language model. You update only those adapters, which cuts memory use and training time while still adapting the model to your task.

instruction: What is JSONL and why is it used for LLM training?
output: JSONL is newline-delimited JSON: one JSON object per line. Training pipelines can stream it row by row without loading the whole file into memory.

instruction: Give three tips for preparing a small CPU fine-tune dataset.
output: 1) Start with 1k–10k high-quality rows, not millions. 2) Remove duplicates and very long examples. 3) Match the format to your technique (Alpaca JSONL for instruction tuning).
